children.name: Evidence
children.value: The 2 SBR headers and 35 SBR payloads have the layout FAAC 2.x writes: headers that send bs_header_extra_1 and not bs_header_extra_2, with start frequency 15, crossover band 0, bs_noise_bands 0 (one noise floor band) and stop frequency 12, none off FAAC's 30-access-unit header period, and data that codes every envelope and noise floor across frequency, with no coupling, sinusoids or extended data

children.name: Evidence
children.value: The version comes from the MP4 ©too atom at 0x1559, which names "FAAC 2.2.0 (6acbe23)" as the writer: software of the same name

findings.message: The moov box follows the mdat box, so a player must read to the end of the file before it can play it (not optimized for streaming, no fast start).
The tkhd box of track 1 gives a duration of 35840 (1.625 s), but its edit list comes to 1.500 s.
